strings: r_c0 starts to fuss with herbs when m_c comes into the medicine den, wincing with each blink. {PRONOUN/r_c0/subject/CAP} gently {VERB/r_c0/ease/eases} {PRONOUN/m_c/object} into a quiet and dark corner of the den to rest.
m_c refuses to uncurl from within the den as the morning sunlight comes in, wincing as a dull throb echoes in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} skull.
